title: My Week at School
text:
I go to school on Monday. I have an English class on Monday. On Tuesday, I have math. On Wednesday, I go to the library.

On Thursday, I stay at home. I read a book and I play with my cat. On Friday, my friends come to my house. We have fun together.

questions.text: What class does the student have on Tuesday?
Who comes to the house on Friday?
How does the student probably feel on Friday?
Why does the student stay at home on Thursday?
options: To relax and enjoy a quiet day
Because the school is closed forever

vocabulary.definition: a place where you can borrow books
a language spoken in many countries
people you like and spend time with
with another person or other people

paragraph_translations: Pazartesi günü okula giderim. Pazartesi günü İngilizce dersim var. Salı günü matematiğim var. Çarşamba günü kütüphaneye giderim.
Perşembe günü evde kalırım. Kitap okur ve kedimle oynarım. Cuma günü arkadaşlarım evime gelir. Birlikte çok eğleniriz.
